sentences.japanese: 君は趣味にそんな大金を費やすべきではなかったのに。
sentences.english: You ought not to have spent so much money on your hobby.

sentences.japanese: 私はむなしく費やした時間を取り戻さなければ。
sentences.english: I must make up for lost time.

sentences.japanese: 学生は多くの時間を勉学に費やす。
sentences.english: A student spends a lot of time studying.

sentences.japanese: 家にたくさんのお金を費やした。
sentences.english: I have spent a lot of money on my house.

sentences.japanese: 医者が多大の努力を費やした患者が回復した。
sentences.english: The doctor devoted a great deal of effort and the patient recovered.
